scripts.extract.py:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).parent;allrows=[]
for listing in sorted((p/'archives').glob('*.listing')):
 rows=[]
 for block in listing.read_text().split('\n\n'):
  d=dict(line.split(' = ',1) for line in block.splitlines() if ' = ' in line)
  name=d.get('Path','');size=int(d.get('Size','0'));ext=Path(name).suffix.lower()
  if size and size<=1500000 and ext in ['.html','.htm','.css','.svg']:
   rows.append({'member':name,'bytes':size,'kind':'html' if ext in ['.html','.htm'] else ext[1:]})
 selected=[]
 for kind,limit in [('html',160),('css',20),('svg',20)]:
  group=[r for r in rows if r['kind']==kind]
  group.sort(key=lambda r:hashlib.sha256(r['member'].encode()).digest())
  selected+=group[:limit]
 archive=Path('/mnt/d/UserData/Documents/mdn-data')/(listing.stem+'.7z');dest=p/'archives'/listing.stem;dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 names=p/'archives'/(listing.stem+'.members');names.write_text('\n'.join(r['member'] for r in selected)+'\n')
 with (p/'logs'/(listing.stem+'.extract.log')).open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(['7z','x','-y','-bd','-bb0','-o'+str(dest),str(archive),'@'+str(names)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 for r in selected:
  file=dest/r['member'];data=file.read_bytes();assert len(data)==r['bytes'];r.update(archive=archive.name,path=str(file),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest());allrows.append(r)
 (p/'corpus-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'selection':'SHA256(member) ascending within kind, <=1.5MB; 160 HTML, 20 CSS, 20 SVG per archive','selected':allrows},indent=2)+'\n')
 print(archive.name,len(selected),flush=True)
scripts.extract-logs.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;rows=[r for r in json.loads((p/'log-members.json').read_text()) if '/logs/' in r['member']]
for archive in sorted(set(r['archive'] for r in rows)):
 selected=[r for r in rows if r['archive']==archive];dest=p/'archives'/archive[:-3];names=p/'archives'/(archive+'.log-members');names.write_text('\n'.join(r['member'] for r in selected)+'\n')
 with (p/'logs'/(archive+'.logs-extract.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run(['7z','x','-y','-bd','-bb0','-o'+str(dest),'/mnt/d/UserData/Documents/mdn-data/'+archive,'@'+str(names)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 for r in selected:
  f=dest/r['member'];r['path']=str(f);r['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(archive,len(selected),flush=True)
(p/'log-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

set -eu
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-mdn-uri-probe-20261005/env.sh
probe_root=/mnt/e/tmp/wse-mdn-uri-probe-20261005
for variant in fixed validation; do
  for mode in normalize rewrite resolve; do
    node --expose-gc "$probe_root/profile-corpus.mjs" "$probe_root/$variant/lib/uri.js" "$mode" "$probe_root/profile-final-$variant-$mode" >> "$probe_root/logs/profiles-final.log" 2>&1
  done
done
for variant in fixed baseline; do
  for mode in normalize rewrite resolve; do
    node --expose-gc "$probe_root/benchmark-corpus.mjs" /mnt/e/tmp/wse-master-wrapper-20261005/dependencies/node_modules/urijs/src/URI.js "$probe_root/$variant/lib/uri.js" "$probe_root/validation/lib/uri.js" "$mode" "$probe_root/performance-$variant-$mode.json" >> "$probe_root/logs/performance.log" 2>&1
  done
done
